title: Pod create rights reach every service account in the namespace
summary: A developer may only create pods in the ci namespace. But a powerful deployer service account lives there too, and any pod can name it in serviceAccountName, so the developer gets cluster-admin through a pod they create.
notes: Permission to create pods, or anything that makes pods (Deployments, Jobs, CronJobs), implicitly includes every service account in that namespace.
Fix: give powerful service accounts their own namespace where only the controller that needs them can create workloads.
Admission policies (ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, Kyverno, Gatekeeper) can restrict which serviceAccountName a pod may use.
Pod Security admission doesn't help here: it controls what a pod can do on the node, not which identity it runs as.
